referenced_urls.title: Benchmarking Task Takeover Across Agent Handoffs

relevance: Continuity when agents hand off work.

media.description: Abstract of the HSC-Bench (Handoff State Continuity) paper with 1,039 task-takeover tasks.
media.ocr_text: As agents collaborate on longer tasks, responsibility may pass between models before the work is complete. The receiving model must build on prior decisions, observations, and actions while addressing the remaining requirements. Evaluating this transition requires connecting the information preserved at handoff to how the receiver continues the work, a relationship that task-success and memory-retention scores alone do not capture. We introduce the Handoff State Continuity Benchmark (HSC-Bench), comprising 1,039 tasks that evaluate two complementary aspects of task takeover: recovering relevant repository evidence and continuing from established conversational, tool, and file-work state.
